name: bootagent-speech-to-text

# Speech to text

Generated by BootAgent. It calls `whisper-1` on the user's PPIO account. BootAgent rewrites this Skill when the model or Provider changes, so do not edit it.

## When to use

When the user asks for the text of an audio recording: transcribing a voice note, a meeting recording or an interview.

## Command

Run the script from the user's working directory, using the absolute path to this Skill:

```bash
node <this Skill's directory>/scripts/run.mjs transcribe --audio <path> [--language <code>] [--prompt "<context>"]
```

- `--audio`: a local audio file (mp3, wav, m4a, webm and similar), at most 25 MB.
- `--language`: the spoken language as an ISO 639-1 code, for example `en` or `zh`. Leave it out to let the model detect it.
- `--prompt`: names or terms that appear in the recording, to help spelling.
- `--timeout`: seconds to wait. Default 300.

The transcript is printed to stdout.

## Rules

- Each run is billed by the length of the audio. Run it when the user asks for a transcript; ask first before transcribing long or many recordings.
- Never print, echo or log environment variables, `~/.bootagent/skill-env/ppio.env`, or anything that could reveal the API key. The script reads the key itself; you never need it.
- Only send files the user asked about. They go to the user's own Provider and nowhere else.

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning | What to tell the user |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | Success | Report the result. |
| 2 | Bad arguments or input file | Fix the command, or ask the user for the right file. |
| 3 | Setup problem: Node.js older than 18, or no API key found | Ask the user to restart the Agent so it picks up `BOOTAGENT_PPIO_API_KEY`, or to reinstall this Skill from BootAgent. |
| 4 | The Provider refused the request | Show the Provider's message. The model may not support this input; the user can choose another model in BootAgent. |
| 5 | The Provider rejected the API key | Ask the user to check the PPIO key in BootAgent. |
| 6 | The Provider was unreachable, busy or timed out | Suggest trying again later. |

`node <this Skill's directory>/scripts/run.mjs check` confirms the key is available without sending a request.
